sloka: ततः प्रसादितो देवैः वसिष्ठो जपताम् वरः ।सख्यम् चकार ब्रह्मर्षिः एवम् अस्तु इति च अब्रवीत् ॥१-६५-२५॥
transliteration: tataḥ prasādito devaiḥ vasiṣṭho japatām varaḥ ।sakhyam cakāra brahmarṣiḥ evam astu iti ca abravīt ॥1-65-25॥

translations.english: "You are a Brahmarshi, no doubt. You will achieve ascetic perfection", said the gods and returned to their respective places from where they had come.
